correctness.rationale: For each three-vertex edge, pure agreeing leaves overwrite only hub, whereas mixed leaves acquire hub color on first activation; pure petals are irrevocable. Positive independent edge-selection weights guarantee almost-sure eventual purification. The first chosen pure-vs-mixed petal decides whether an initially opposed hub succeeds when all pure petals have one color; two pure colors forbid consensus. Direct Bernoulli independent-initial calculation yields P0=(1−p)²(1+2p)(1−p²)^(m−1) and P1=p²(3−2p)[p(2−p)]^(m−1), independent of weights; total at p=1/2=(3/4)^(m−1), p=λ/sqrt(m)→e^(−λ²). After purification, fresh weighted draws give i.i.d hub opinions, while uniform coupon collection yields mH_r or 1+mH_r conditional means. Independent exact enumeration of all binary states, with unequal positive rational edge weights for m=1..6 and three p choices (18 parameter cases), matched both color probabilities; full m proof uses state invariants.
